info.title: Uncloud API
info.description: REST API for managing Uncloud clusters. Every endpoint except /healthz requires the sidecar's bearer token.

get.summary: Inspect an image in its remote registry

parameters.name: available
parameters.description: Only return machines that are not down.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: System service name, such as uncloud or docker.

parameters.name: follow
parameters.description: Keep the connection open for new log entries.

parameters.name: tail
parameters.description: Number of recent lines to return. Use -1 for all lines.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Show logs since this Docker timestamp.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Show logs until this Docker timestamp.

parameters.name: containers
parameters.description: Comma-separated service container names or IDs.
